info.title: BidiLint — lint localization files for bidi (bidirectional text) pitfalls.
info.description: Lint Arabic/English localization files for bidi pitfalls: missing keys, unisolated Latin runs, mixed numeral systems, unbalanced isolates.

options.name: --base
options.description: Base culture every other file is compared against (default: en).

options.name: --strict
options.description: Exit 4 when any error is found (built for CI gates).
